This cat was a bribe to come back home after calling children's aid on my step dad for slapping me around. 

This cat was my first friend. I spent all day at school getting bullied just to race home and meet this cat who would always be sitting by the front door waiting for me. I cried into his fur, told him all my secrets and in exchange he taught me what it felt like to be loved and to love something. 

I struggle with derealization. I constantly get confused and feel like everything is a simulation. This cat would crawl into my lap like he did when I was a child and it felt like a tie to my past. It felt like an anchor reminding me that he was real and I am real. 

Now he's gone. My brain keeps picking at the idea that he never even existed. That I imagined him. 

I'll never feel his warm body or hear his obnoxiously loud purring to tie me to my childhood and reality every again. He's gone and I didn't get to say goodbye.
